title: Capital Gains Manual
summary:
HMRC is reviewing the CG Manual to ensure it provides
HMRC’s interpretation of relevant legislation where there is more than one
reasonable view of how rules work.Where material in the CG Manual isn’t
providing an interpretation, that material is being removed. Where appropriate,
material will be reproduced elsewhere and linked from the CG Manual.

title: Online services for agents
summary: Information about services available to agents, including Self Assessment and PAYE for agents online services, multi-factor authentication, calculators and the HMRC App. Find out about service availability and any current issues.

title: The Tax Agent's Handbook
summary: Information to help tax agents and advisers find guidance, use HMRC's services and contact HMRC.

title: Apply for an increase in tax credits for a backdated disability benefit decision
summary: Ask for a backdated disability benefit decision to be included in a period when you were claiming Working Tax Credit or Child Tax Credit.

title: Guidance: Data Element 2/3: Documents and Other Reference Codes (Union) of the Customs Declaration Service (CDS)
summary: Find the relevant document codes, document status codes and details to be declared such as licences and certificates (Appendix 5A).

title: Official Statistics: Non-domestic rating: business floorspace, March 2026
summary: Statistics on the floorspace of a range of classes of properties on the 2023 rating list as at 31 March 2026.

title: Guidance: Approved payers in the middleman scheme
summary: Check this list of approved payers for non-UK resident entertainers and find out if you need to deduct withholding tax.

title: Authorising an agent to deal with your tax affairs
summary: Check what a paid agent can do on your behalf. How you authorise the agent depends on the tax, and you may need to use paper form 64-8 or an online service.

title: Compliance Handbook
summary: The aim of the Compliance Handbook is to help users understand and apply HMRC's penalties and compliance powers, as set out by legislation.

title: Identify tax scams by phone, text, email or social media
summary: Use this checklist to decide if a suspicious phone call, text message (SMS), email or social media account is a scam.

title: Tell HMRC the value of items in your PAYE Settlement Agreement
summary: Use form PSA1 or send an informal calculation to tell HMRC about the value of items included in your PAYE Settlement Agreement.

title: Statutory guidance: Reference Documents for The Customs (Tariff Quotas) (EU Exit) Regulations 2020
summary: Check the documents that detail product specific tariff-rate quotas, including the individual product volumes and rates, and also list of eligible goods and their authorised uses.

title: Statutory guidance: Reference Document for The Customs Tariff (Establishment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2020
summary: Find the UK’s most favoured nation tariff rates as referenced in The Customs Tariff (Establishment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2020.

title: Statutory guidance: Reference Documents for The Customs Tariff (Suspension of Import Duty Rates) (EU Exit) Regulations 2020
summary: Find out about the tariff suspensions that apply from the end of the transition period.

title: Notice: Registered consignees (Excise Notice 203a)
summary: This notice sets out the UK's requirements for the commercial movement of excise goods by a Registered Consignee.

title: Guidance: Real Time Information internet submissions: 2027 to 2028 technical specifications
summary: Real Time Information (RTI) Rules and Interface Management (RIM) artefacts and supporting technical specifications for software developers.

title: Check if a business is registered for money laundering supervision
summary: Find out if a business has registered with HMRC under the money laundering regulations and report them if they have not.

title: Draft legislation: Plastic packaging tax — chemical recycling and adoption of a mass balance approach
summary: This technical consultation seeks views on draft regulations and supporting document for the Plastic Packaging Tax mass balance approach for chemically recycled plastic.

title: Research: Local reference rents, listed by BRMA and property size (September 2026)
summary: Local reference rent (LRR) levels by number of rooms and broad rental market areas (BRMA) for residential properties in England in September 2026.

title: Guidance: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports
summary: This guide provides detailed completion instructions for data elements when making a written export declaration to the Customs Declaration Service (CDS).
